title: How To Plan a Social Media Content Calendar Part 2
description:
Here is our part 2 series of how we planned our 2022 content calendar. Planning your content in advance will keep you prepared for the entire year. Remember to stick to a routine and schedule makes sense for your businesses vision, mission and goals. You're more than capable, it just all starts with a plan. 
 Give this video a thumbs up if you found it helpful. Feel free to follow me along on my journey as we enter the new year.
